Every patch receives an answer from the latents. Then the 20 × 20 × 20 grid of patches is enlarged to 100 × 100 × 100 voxels: the values between neighboring patches are filled in smoothly, as when enlarging an image (this is trilinear upsampling), and a convolution gives every voxel 64 features.
После обратного кросс-внимания и повышен: After the reverse cross-attention and upsampling, each of the million voxels has 64 features.
Токенизатор CLIP всегда выдаёт 77 токено: CLIP's tokenizer always outputs 77 tokens, padding a short command with empty ones, and the encoder gives a vector per token.

Max-pool берёт по каждому из 64 признако: Max-pool takes, for each of the 64 features, its largest value over all voxels: 64 numbers describing the whole scene remain. A linear layer turns them into scores for the rotation bins: 72 bins of 5° for each of the three axes.
Каждый воксель получает цвет, координаты: Every voxel gets a color, the point's coordinates, whether it is occupied, and its index in the grid.
